summary: Calm on the surface, hollow underneath. 24 messages, no blow-up, no new fan-trust incident — the first clean week since the Jul 17 cluster began — and Vale paid the Aug 1-14 invoice two days after it landed without being nudged. But the thing that mattered most going into this week did not happen: nine days after her paid private 1:1 live was cut up and resold as PPV to the very fan who bought it, the only remedy on record is still Ollie's Aug 12 'spoke to the MM PPV specialist for your account'. Nothing was documented, nothing was confirmed pulled, and the subject was never raised again by anyone on the ALTR side. Same for the unauthorized girl-girl videos she asked to be purged on Aug 1/2 — 20 days, still no confirmation. Ollie's Aug 9 promise to schedule her outstanding lives 'this week' lapsed entirely: Ryan ($600), John ($1,800 videocall), the outstanding lives and Tyler's custom were not mentioned once in the window, and for the first time since May 22 Vale stopped asking about them. The one new event was the week's worst finding: on Aug 18 Ollie surfaced a custom that fan John paid $2k for in May that Vale had never been told about — 'I don't know if you ever saw it' — discovered only because 'Google sheets is acting weird'. That is the same OnlyFans account (u490240243) as the $1,800 videocall Fred logged on May 1 and that Ollie himself chased her about on Aug 3, so ALTR's own records cannot say whether this fan is owed one delivery or two. Ollie then took another $200 from him for ASAP delivery, and when Vale asked a blocking question about the request that same evening he said 'Ill find out for you now' and answered 37 hours later — after which she apologised for the delay. Real bright spots: no @-escalation was needed all week (Mayson tagged Ollie three times last week, zero this week), Ollie brought in $400 of upsells, Stephski's pre-invoice withdrawal reminder is back, and Michelle's leak-removal report landed on cadence.
